standard.summary: 选择对哪些模块/部分应用编译：auto（自动）/ inner_forward（block 内部 forward）/ block（整块 block）。
standard.effect: inner_forward 优先编译 block 内的稳定 forward 路径，跳过外层动态路由；block 编译整个 transformer block。Anima 测试中 inner_forward 效果更稳定。
standard.whenToUse: Anima 推荐 inner_forward；其他路线保持 auto（自动探测最适合的目标）。
standard.avoidWhen: block 模式在有动态分支的 block 上可能导致编译失败或频繁重编译。

optionDescriptions.block: 整 block 编，范围大，动态分支容易断图。
optionDescriptions.inner_forward: 只编 Attention/MLP 内核，分支少，Anima 上少出事。

standard_en.summary: Which modules or parts get compiled: auto / inner_forward (the forward inside a block) / block (the whole block).
standard_en.effect: inner_forward compiles the stable forward path inside each block first and skips the dynamic routing around it; block compiles the entire transformer block. In Anima testing inner_forward proved steadier.
standard_en.whenToUse: inner_forward is recommended for Anima; leave other routes on auto (it probes for the best target).
standard_en.avoidWhen: The block mode can fail to compile, or recompile repeatedly, on blocks that contain dynamic branches.

optionDescriptions.auto: Picks which level to compile automatically.
optionDescriptions.block: Compiles the whole block: wide scope, and dynamic branches easily break the graph.
optionDescriptions.inner_forward: Compiles only the attention/MLP kernels: fewer branches, fewer problems on Anima.

advanced.principle: inner_forward = 只编译 Attention + MLP 的核心计算路径，绕过 block 外层的条件逻辑（如 timestep 路由、跳层逻辑）；block = 完整编译整个 block 单元。
advanced.tradeoffs: inner_forward 编译范围更小但更稳定；block 编译范围更大但遇到动态分支时容易触发 graph break。

advanced_en.principle: inner_forward = compiles only the Attention + MLP core compute path, bypassing the block's outer conditional logic (timestep routing, layer-skip logic); block = compiles the entire block unit.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: inner_forward compiles less but is more stable; block compiles more but easily graph-breaks on dynamic branches.
